title: StationCalibration
description: Calibration factors for a specific station and validity period. Applied to raw sensor values before forwarding to the SensorThings API.

no2Factor.description: Multiplicative calibration factor for NO₂ raw values.

pm25Factor.description: Multiplicative calibration factor for PM2,5 raw values.

coFactor.description: Multiplicative calibration factor for CO raw values.

validFrom.description: Date from which this calibration is valid (ISO-8601).

validUntil.description: Date until which this calibration is valid (ISO-8601). Absent = currently valid.
